name: LedgerPort – QuickBooks Sync for WooCommerce – E-commerce Accounting Automation
author: LedgerPort

sections.description:
WooCommerce QuickBooks Integration That Automates Your E-commerce Accounting

Every month, the same scene plays out. You export a payout report from WooCommerce or Stripe, open QuickBooks Online, and stare at two numbers that should match. They don’t. Payouts arrive as net disbursements: gross sales minus fees, refunds, and adjustments. QuickBooks records transactions as they’re entered. Neither is wrong. They’re speaking different languages.

Most WooCommerce store owners fall into one of three camps. Reconcile manually every month and lose 4+ hours. Give up and run on increasingly unreliable books. Or automate the translation layer.

LedgerPort is the translation layer. The WordPress plugin connects your WooCommerce store to LedgerPort, which keeps QuickBooks Online in sync with every order, refund, and deposit. Automatically. Accurately. No CSV exports, no manual data entry, no month-end bookkeeping marathon — just accurate e-commerce accounting through a QuickBooks integration built for WooCommerce.

LedgerPort Free & Paid Plans
The Free plan syncs up to 30 WooCommerce orders per month to QuickBooks Online — no credit card required. Paid plans start at $29/mo and add higher order volume, automated sync, payout reconciliation (Scale and up), and multi-store dashboards. Every paid plan is covered by a 14-day, 100% money-back guarantee. See LedgerPort pricing to pick your plan.

QuickBooks Online Sync Features

  • Webhook-driven order sync — no polling. Order, refund, and customer events leave your store the moment they happen. Posting to QuickBooks runs on demand on Free, daily on Growth, and continuously in real time on Scale and Enterprise.
  • Product, customer, and payout sync. Read mode on install. Write mode is opt-in.
  • QuickBooks payout reconciliation (Scale and Enterprise). Splits Stripe and WooCommerce Payments deposits into transaction-level detail you can match line by line.
  • Inventory sync with location controls (Scale and Enterprise). Keep stock quantities aligned between WooCommerce and QuickBooks Online.
  • Multi-business accounting. One LedgerPort account, multiple connected WooCommerce stores and QuickBooks files — up to 3 storefronts on Scale, unlimited on Enterprise.
  • Full audit log. Every sync action logged. Retry failed events. Export to CSV for compliance.
  • HPOS-native. Built for WooCommerce 8+ and high-performance order storage from day 1. No compatibility-mode tradeoffs.

Payout Reconciliation for Stripe & WooCommerce Payments

When Stripe deposits $4,287.32 on Tuesday, LedgerPort splits it into the exact orders and transaction fees that produced it. No more matching one deposit line against 47 orders manually. Your bank feed in QuickBooks Online matches your books line by line — the part of e-commerce bookkeeping that eats the most hours is the part LedgerPort automates best. Payout journals and fee handling are included on the Scale and Enterprise plans.

Refunds, partial refunds, order edits, and cancellations follow automatically, so QuickBooks stays reconciled even when the sale doesn’t go as planned.

Why Stores Switch to LedgerPort for QuickBooks Sync

Stop the Friday CSV export.
On Scale and Enterprise, orders post to QuickBooks the moment they happen; Growth runs a daily automated sync. Refunds, edits, and cancellations follow automatically. Stores that used to run this manually report 8 to 12 hours of bookkeeping recovered every month. Need a one-time push instead? Manual sync controls cover products, variations, orders, and customers:

One account, many businesses.
Manage up to 3 connected WooCommerce stores and QuickBooks Online files from one dashboard on the Scale plan — or unlimited storefronts on Enterprise. Built for accountants, agencies, and operators running portfolios.

Accounting that survives an audit.
Every sync event is logged with full request and response detail, filterable history, and CSV export. Your bookkeeper (or the IRS) can trace any QuickBooks entry back to its WooCommerce order.

Modern WooCommerce stack.
Built for stores running 100,000+ orders without degradation. The plugin declares high-performance order storage (HPOS) compatibility through WooCommerce’s standard mechanism, so HPOS-enabled stores work natively from the moment the plugin activates.

Who Uses This WooCommerce Accounting Plugin

Store owners who want bookkeeping automated — subscription boxes, apparel, digital downloads, supplements, courses, and every store in between. CPAs and bookkeepers managing client stores who need transaction-level QuickBooks data with an audit trail per client (custom wholesale pricing is available for CPA partners at ledgerport.com/cpas). Agencies running multiple client businesses on a unified dashboard.

Full LedgerPort Feature List

  • Webhook-driven WooCommerce order sync to QuickBooks Online (real-time continuous posting on Scale and Enterprise; daily on Growth; on-demand on Free).
  • Stripe payout reconciliation with transaction-level detail (Scale and Enterprise).
  • WooCommerce Payments payout split into individual transactions (Scale and Enterprise).
  • Inventory sync with location controls (Scale and Enterprise).
  • Multi-business dashboard for connected stores and QuickBooks files (up to 3 on Scale, unlimited on Enterprise).
  • QuickBooks chart of accounts mapping for products, taxes, and shipping.
  • Full audit log with filterable history and CSV export.
  • OAuth 2.0 PKCE setup wizard.
  • Explicit consent screen before any resources are created on your store.
  • Auto-provisioned WooCommerce REST API key, scoped to LedgerPort.
  • WooCommerce webhooks for orders, products, customers, refunds, and product variations.
  • HMAC-signed webhook payloads with a per-connection shared secret.
  • Site Health integration for connection status.
  • HTTPS enforcement with a development-mode override.
  • HPOS native compatibility from day 1.
  • Multi-currency support for any country LedgerPort and QuickBooks Online support.
  • Refund and partial refund propagation to QuickBooks.
  • Order edit and cancellation propagation.
  • Manual push controls for one-time syncs of recent data.
  • Manual pull controls to import from QuickBooks Online.
  • Per-event retry on transient failures.
  • Plugin auto-deactivates if WooCommerce is missing.
  • Encrypted storage for connection credentials.
  • Random hash-suffixed log filenames with .htaccess and web.config deny rules dropped automatically.
  • Translation-ready (.pot file included).
  • Clean uninstall — removes the WooCommerce REST API key, webhooks, options, transients, and log directory.

LedgerPort Pricing

Pay based on order volume — not on features you’ll never use.

  • Free — $0 forever. 1 storefront, up to 30 orders/month, manual sync on demand, order & refund sync, community support. No credit card required.
  • Growth — $29/mo ($25/mo billed annually). 1 storefront, up to 1,000 orders/month, daily automated sync, standard email support.
  • Scale — $79/mo ($67/mo billed annually). Up to 3 storefronts, 5,000 orders/month, real-time continuous sync, payout journals & fee handling, priority 24/7 support. Most popular.
  • Enterprise — $199/mo ($169/mo billed annually). Unlimited storefronts and orders, purchase order sync, gift card & store credit accounting, dedicated account manager.

Annual billing saves up to 15%. Every paid plan carries a 14-day, 100%, no-questions-asked money-back guarantee. See the LedgerPort pricing page for the full comparison matrix.

Better Than Webgility, A2X, Synder & Other QuickBooks Integrations

If you’ve researched WooCommerce QuickBooks integrations, you’ve probably seen Webgility, A2X, Synder, Amaka, Bookkeep, Connex, Zapier, and QuickBooks Connector (OneSaas). Most were built for Shopify or Amazon first, with WooCommerce support bolted on through generic APIs and polling schedules.

LedgerPort takes the opposite approach: a WordPress-native plugin built for WooCommerce first. Webhook events instead of polling. HPOS support from day one. An explicit consent screen before anything touches your store, and a free plan to start — no credit card, no per-order surprise fees. If you need QuickBooks Desktop rather than QuickBooks Online, a legacy tool like Webgility may fit better; LedgerPort is focused on doing QuickBooks Online sync exceptionally well.

Built by the Team Behind PushEngage

LedgerPort is built by the team behind PushEngage, part of the Awesome Motive family — the people behind WPForms, MonsterInsights, OptinMonster, and other tools that run on over 25 million websites. E-commerce accounting is a trust business, and we’ve been earning WordPress users’ trust for over a decade.

Branding Guidelines

When writing about the LedgerPort WooCommerce QuickBooks sync plugin, please use the correct branding:

  • LedgerPort (correct)
  • Ledger Port (incorrect — no space between words)
  • Ledgerport (incorrect — the P must be capitalized)
  • ledger port plugin (incorrect)

Connect WooCommerce to QuickBooks Online Today

Connect WooCommerce to QuickBooks Online in under 5 minutes. The Free plan covers stores doing up to 30 orders per month — no credit card required — and every paid plan is backed by a 14-day money-back guarantee.

QuickBooks and QuickBooks Online are trademarks of Intuit Inc. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. LedgerPort is not affiliated with or endorsed by Intuit or Automattic.

External services

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the LedgerPort SaaS at https://api.ledgerport.com to sync orders, products, and customers to QuickBooks Online. It requires a free LedgerPort account.

Endpoints contacted:

  • https://api.ledgerport.com/v1/oauth/* — OAuth 2.0 PKCE handshake during initial setup.
  • https://api.ledgerport.com/v1/connections/woocommerce — webhook registration and connection state.
  • https://api.ledgerport.com/v1/events/incoming — receives WooCommerce webhook payloads (orders, refunds, products, customers, payouts).
  • https://api.ledgerport.com/v1/sync/status — polled by the plugin admin UI to display sync health and recent activity.

What is sent: WooCommerce order data, product data, customer data, and payout data. Sync is triggered by WooCommerce webhooks and on-demand REST API calls initiated by the LedgerPort server.

Service documents:

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
  • Data Processing Agreement

QuickBooks Online is connected via OAuth from the LedgerPort dashboard. QuickBooks data flows are governed by Intuit’s own Terms and Privacy Policy.

Privacy Policy

WooCommerce data transmitted by this plugin: orders, products, customers, and payouts.

Sync only starts after you complete OAuth setup, which includes an explicit consent screen for the WooCommerce REST API key and webhook creation. The plugin does not transmit any data before this consent is given.

Webhooks are signed with HMAC using a shared secret per connection. HTTPS is required for production sites. Local development environments can bypass the HTTPS check by defining LEDGERPORT_ALLOW_HTTP in wp-config.php.

Customers exercising GDPR or CCPA rights can be removed from LedgerPort by contacting support@ledgerport.com or via the LedgerPort dashboard’s data deletion tool. Erasure requests propagate to LedgerPort sub-processors per the DPA linked above.

Sub-processors per LedgerPort DPA Schedule 1: Google Cloud Platform, Stripe, Intuit, FreeScout, Lindris. All sub-processors are based in the United States.

Data retention is governed by the LedgerPort DPA linked above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/ledgerport/, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and select the LedgerPort zip.
  2. Activate LedgerPort through the Plugins screen.
  3. With WooCommerce active, the setup wizard launches automatically. Follow the prompts to authenticate with LedgerPort and connect QuickBooks Online via OAuth.
  4. On the consent screen, approve the creation of a WooCommerce REST API key and webhooks. These resources are required for sync.
  5. Once setup completes, the first sync runs automatically.

LedgerPort activates on any WordPress site, but syncing requires WooCommerce 8.0 or later — if WooCommerce isn’t active yet, LedgerPort shows a guided prompt to install it. HTTPS is required for production sites.

The full, unobfuscated TypeScript/React source for the admin UI is published. Build instructions and the complete third-party library list (runtime + build tooling, versions, source links, licenses) are documented in README.md at the plugin root.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

LedgerPort is a connector. The WordPress plugin authenticates your WooCommerce store with LedgerPort, sets up webhooks, and lets LedgerPort sync your store data to QuickBooks Online. The actual sync work happens on LedgerPort’s servers.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes — LedgerPort syncs WooCommerce data, so WooCommerce 8.0+ must be installed and active for syncing to work. You can activate LedgerPort first, though: it installs cleanly without WooCommerce, shows you what each screen does, and gives you a one-click prompt to install and activate WooCommerce when you’re ready.

What does LedgerPort cost?

LedgerPort offers a free plan and three paid tiers. The Free plan covers up to 30 orders per month with 1 storefront. Paid plans start at $29 per month (Growth), with Scale at $79/mo and Enterprise at $199/mo. Annual billing saves up to 15%. See the LedgerPort pricing page for current plan details.

Is there a free trial?

There’s no time-limited trial — the Free plan is the entry point and stays free forever (30 orders/month, no credit card). Every paid plan is covered by a 14-day, 100%, no-questions-asked money-back guarantee, so you can try any tier risk-free.

Do I need a LedgerPort account?

Yes. The plugin requires a free LedgerPort account because the plugin is a connector. Without the LedgerPort service, the plugin cannot sync to QuickBooks. Account creation takes about two minutes and happens during the setup wizard.

Does LedgerPort work with QuickBooks Desktop?

No. LedgerPort syncs to QuickBooks Online only. QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Self-Employed are not supported.

Does this require HTTPS?

Yes. WooCommerce REST API credentials and webhook payloads need a secure connection. Most WordPress hosts offer free SSL via Let’s Encrypt. For local development, define LEDGERPORT_ALLOW_HTTP in wp-config.php to bypass the check.

What happens if I disconnect? Are my QuickBooks records affected?

Disconnecting from LedgerPort does not touch your QuickBooks data. The plugin removes its WooCommerce REST API key and webhooks from your store. Records already synced to QuickBooks stay there. To stop QuickBooks-side syncing entirely, disconnect QuickBooks from your LedgerPort dashboard separately.

Does LedgerPort support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. LedgerPort is HPOS-native from version 1.0.0. The plugin is built for WooCommerce 8+ and high-performance order storage from day one. The plugin declares HPOS compatibility through WooCommerce’s standard mechanism.

Which QuickBooks Online plans does this work with?

LedgerPort works with all QuickBooks Online plans: Simple Start, Essentials, Plus, and Advanced. None of the Advanced-only features are required. Supports any QuickBooks Online country and currency configuration.

Does it sync historical orders, or only new ones going forward?

Version 1.0.0 syncs new orders only. Anything that comes into WooCommerce after setup syncs automatically. Bulk backfill for historical orders is on the version 1.1.0 roadmap.

Can I sync multiple WooCommerce stores to one QuickBooks Online file?

Yes. The multi-business architecture supports up to 3 connected storefronts on the Scale plan and unlimited storefronts on Enterprise — one LedgerPort account and one paid plan covers them all. Custom wholesale pricing is available for CPA and accounting firms.

Does it handle refunds, partial refunds, and order edits?

Yes. Refunds, partial refunds, and order edits trigger webhook events that LedgerPort processes automatically. QuickBooks stays in sync with whatever changes happen in WooCommerce.

What does the audit log capture?

Every sync action. Successful syncs, failed events, retries, manual pushes, and pulls. The log is filterable by date, type, and status. Export to CSV for compliance and review.

Is data sent in real time, or on a schedule?

Webhook events fire the moment a change happens in WooCommerce — the plugin does not run on a polling schedule. How often those events post to QuickBooks Online depends on your plan: on demand on Free, daily automated on Growth, and continuous real-time on Scale and Enterprise.

Are debug log files protected from public access?

Yes. Log files are stored under wp-content/uploads/ledgerport/logs/ with random hash-suffixed filenames. The plugin drops .htaccess (Apache and LiteSpeed) and web.config (IIS) deny rules automatically. For Nginx, add this to your server config if your host does not already block direct access under wp-content/uploads/:

location ~* /wp-content/uploads/ledgerport/logs/.* { deny all; }

How do I report a bug?

Open a support ticket through your LedgerPort dashboard, or visit LedgerPort support.

1.0.3

  • Changed: WooCommerce is no longer a hard activation requirement. LedgerPort now activates on any site and shows a guided install/activate WooCommerce prompt (admin notice + in-app page previews) instead of blocking activation.

1.0.2

  • Security hardening: your LedgerPort credentials now stay server-side and never reach the browser.
  • Stronger debug-log privacy and a leaner, tidier admin app under the hood.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: connection rollback now releases the LedgerPort connection after a failed post-register step (e.g. currency mismatch), so retries can store fresh WooCommerce credentials.
  • Source-code disclosure and third-party library list moved from this file to README.md. Source still ships in the plugin zip under assets/.

  • Manual push and pull tools for on-demand syncing.
  • Chart of accounts mapping editor.
  • Audit logs with filterable history and CSV export.
  • Site Health integration.
  • HPOS-native. Multi-business support.
